primitives.name: Pundit Claim Accountability
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Pundit-claim accountability**: log paraphrased, attributed, dated claims ("Mans on X player, week N") and grade them publicly over time.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C_i(t)': 'Claim i at time t, categorical label', 'A_i': 'Attribution vector for claim i, dimensionless', 'G_i': 'Grade assigned to claim i, real-valued [0,1]'}
primitives.assumptions: Claims are paraphrased and dated; grading is consistent and verifiable.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When A_i is missing or G_i is undefined, accountability fails.

layer2.mapping: GSI's claim tracking kernel derives from RSS-based temporal indexing, enabling GSE to perform state transitions on claim validity.
layer2.telemetry: Logged claim entries with timestamp and attribution match RSS metadata

primitives.name: Proprietary Data Isolation
primitives.verbatim_quote: **NOT wanted as model input**: his picks/analysis are proprietary predictions — `data-rules.ts` forbids extracting them as engine inputs, license or no license.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P(t)': 'Proprietary content indicator at time t, binary-valued', 'I(t)': 'Input eligibility function, binary-valued'}
primitives.assumptions: Proprietary content cannot be extracted regardless of licensing status.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When I(t) = 1 and P(t) = 1, isolation fails.

layer2.mapping: GSE's input filtering logic mirrors the data-rules.ts constraint, ensuring that P(t) = 1 implies I(t) = 0 in all automated pipelines.
layer2.telemetry: Automated extraction jobs flagged when P(t) = 1
